ScribeCat 0.28.2 improves linked blocks, context menus and GitHub documentation.

- Linked blocks have a clearer border and a slightly darker background.
- Table actions use the same bottom-sheet context menu as other actions on phones.
- Desktop context menus stay within the screen and scroll when their contents are tall.
- The GitHub overview and feature guide describe the current app and its macOS, Windows, Linux and server editions. Obsolete interface images were removed.
